bookingChecklist.notes: JetBlue B6 841 & B6 72 — $989/person round-trip (Blue Basic). Prices will go up as July approaches.
Ryanair FR1676, Jul 20, departs Shannon 4:00pm → Edinburgh 5:15pm. ~$50/person one-way. Book at ryanair.com. Ryanair charges extra for checked bags ($25-40) and seat selection.
July is peak season. Good hotels sell out months ahead.
Galway has fewer hotel options than Dublin — book early. Check out Jul 20 morning, bus or shuttle to Shannon for 4pm flight.
Arrive ~6pm Jul 20 from Shannon flight. Check out morning Jul 23 before Highlands tour. Ask hotel to store luggage while away. Edinburgh is expensive in July — book ASAP.
Check in after Highlands tour returns ~7pm. Same hotel as Part 1 if possible (your luggage is there). Fly out Jul 25 at 12:10 PM.
Jul 23-24. Rabbie's (~$185/person) or Haggis Adventures (~$169/person). Accommodation NOT included — add B&B at checkout (~£40-80/person). These sell out weeks ahead in summer.

bookingChecklist.item: Cliffs of Moher Day Tour from Galway
bookingChecklist.notes: Jul 18. Galway Tour Company (~$40/person). Small-group tours sell out in peak season.

bookingChecklist.item: Connemara or Aran Islands Day Trip
bookingChecklist.notes: Jul 19. Connemara tour (~$35/person) or Aran Islands ferry (~$30/person). Aran Islands is weather-dependent — have Connemara as backup.
Jul 15. Timed entry, $18/person. Morning slots are best. Often sells out in summer.
$8/person. This is THE hardest ticket to get in Dublin — sells out weeks ahead. Book the moment tickets open.
Jul 21. $19/person. Book a morning slot to beat the crowds.
Jul 15. $26/person. Book online for a discount. Optional — skip if not interested.
Jul 17. ~$20/person. Book online for cheaper 'web fare' prices. Trains run hourly from Dublin Heuston.

Jul 20. Option A: Bus Eireann (~$12/person, depart ~12:05pm from Galway Coach Station, 1h 45m). Option B: Galway Shuttle (~$140 total, private hotel pickup, ~1h 15m). Both get you there with plenty of time for the 4pm Ryanair flight.
Book fine dining now: Chapter One (Dublin), The Kitchin (Edinburgh). Mid-range can wait 2-4 weeks. Kai in Galway — call to reserve.

bookingChecklist.item: Scotch Whisky Experience or Teeling Distillery
bookingChecklist.notes: Optional. Can usually book a few days ahead or walk up.

Dublin.rain: Frequent light showers (14 rainy days avg)
Dublin.note: Pack layers. Irish summer is mild — t-shirt weather some days, jacket weather others. Rain is usually light but frequent.

Galway.rain: Wetter than Dublin (west coast catches Atlantic weather)
Galway.note: Galway gets more rain than Dublin. A good waterproof jacket is essential, especially for cliff walks and Aran Islands.

Edinburgh.rain: Drier than Ireland but still changeable
Edinburgh.note: Similar to Dublin. Highlands will be cooler — bring warm layers for the 2-day tour. Wind can be brisk at elevation.

items: UK/Ireland power adaptor (Type G — 3 flat prongs)
Copies of all bookings (digital + paper backup)
Light hiking shoes for Howth, Arthur's Seat, Highlands
One nice outfit for fine dining (Chapter One, The Kitchin)
Rain pants or quick-dry pants for hiking days
Sun hat + sunglasses (16+ hours of daylight)
Small overnight bag for Highlands tour (leave main luggage at hotel)
Motion sickness meds (ferries, winding Highland roads)
Sunscreen (UV is strong even when cloudy)
Earplugs + eye mask (jet lag + bright evenings)

preTripChecklist.notes: US citizens don't need a visa for Ireland or UK (stays under 90 days)
Cover trip cancellation, medical, and baggage. Ireland/UK healthcare is not free for US visitors.
Check if your carrier includes Ireland/UK data. T-Mobile includes it free. Otherwise buy a local SIM at Dublin Airport.

preTripChecklist.item: Notify bank/credit card of travel dates
preTripChecklist.notes: Ireland uses EUR (€), UK/Scotland uses GBP (£). Cards are accepted almost everywhere.
Ireland and UK use the same plug type (3 flat rectangular prongs). Buy 2-3 adaptors. NOT the same as continental Europe.
Google Maps or Apple Maps offline for Dublin, Galway, Edinburgh, and Highlands. Cell service is spotty in rural areas.
Covers DART, buses, Luas tram. Buy at Dublin Airport on arrival or pre-order online.

preTripChecklist.item: Register with STEP (Smart Traveler Enrollment Program)
preTripChecklist.notes: US State Department travel enrollment. Free — helps embassy reach you in emergencies.
Ireland emergency: 112 or 999. UK emergency: 999. US Embassy Dublin: +353 1 668 8777. US Consulate Edinburgh: +44 131 556 8315.
